_comment: Per-carline config for the monthly Sprint Room run. chart_roles maps a role to the chartN.xml the skeleton builder produces for the NEW month's slide (skill duplicates last month's charts into 9-12). Verify against the actual deck when verify_chart_roles is true. See ../../docs/slide-configs.md.

Explorer.notes: Original template; the skill's documented default order.

Kuga.notes: EU5. build_skeleton hardcodes EU7 in the subtitle regex - fix subtitle manually. Sentiment series names are Capitalised ('Positive Pre'/'Negative Pre').

Capri.notes: EU7; 6 competitors. Watch the towing-PR NEAR/5 query asymmetry vs Explorer.

Puma.notes: EU5; 4 competitors + Puma = 5 sentiment bars (Y coords 3,9,15,21,27). Verified on the Sep 2026 deck: latest slide = chart1 volume, chart2 country, chart3 platform, chart4 sentiment (so the skeleton's chart9-12 map as above). Charts already embed their own xlsx (sheets 'Sheet1' x3, 'Puma' for sentiment) and the diamond series are named after the prior month ('Positive September'), so the skill's update/embed scripts don't fit: use `run.py rollforward` (tools/rollforward_deck.py) instead of skeleton/charts/bullets/embed/pack.
